name: Geode
desc: Standing inside the vug of a cracked mineral nodule: banded agate walls of periodic precipitation recede into haze, a palisade of quartz points crowds inward off every surface and pipes light to its tips, near shards frame the mouth almost black with rim-light, and a shaft from the fissure above rakes slowly across the cavity with mineral dust turning in it; offered as a lit amethyst cavity, longwave-UV fluorescence, a hatched mineralogical engraving, or a crystallographic blueprint.

energy.doc: light strength: shaft width, specular glints on the palisade, overall contrast

scale.doc: size of the crystal palisade against the cavity - fine druse vs huge blades crowding the frame

speed.doc: rate the fissure light swings, the camera sways and the dust turns (0.2 still drifts)

density.doc: how many crystals line the cavity, and how thick the dust hangs

bands.doc: agate band frequency on the back wall - a few broad layers vs tight banding

grain.doc: film tooth over the whole plate

hue.doc: hue of the crystals; the agate wall and shaft light take related tints

x.doc: horizontal centre of the cavity mouth - the palisade re-aims at it

y.doc: vertical centre of the cavity mouth

style.doc: aesthetic: lit amethyst cavity in chiaroscuro / longwave-UV fluorescence where only the beam excites / hatched mineralogical engraving, form from ink density alone / crystallographic blueprint

seed.doc: deterministic cavity: agate banding, crystal placement and habits
